segment_contamination_dimensions: RCC/permanent construction buyer segment: sibling 'RCC Labour Quarter' (ID 216129) targets buyers procuring permanent or semi-permanent reinforced concrete worker quarters — a different construction method, durability tier, and procurement context from prefabricated/temporary MS-GI frame colonies; names implying permanent RCC or brick-masonry construction are blocked.

General prefabricated building buyer segment: siblings 'Prefabricated Buildings' (ID 35589), 'Prefabricated Industrial Buildings' (ID 178587), 'Prefabricated Steel Buildings' (ID 20474), and 'Modular Buildings' (ID 33188) attract buyers seeking commercial, industrial, or institutional prefab structures — not worker accommodation colonies; names that omit the labour/worker accommodation function and read as generic prefab buildings are blocked to prevent cross-contamination.
